title: D1 — the unpinned route-parameter grammar, and what it costs the address
description: The signed bundle authors `/receipt/:caseRef`. Surface v0.1 §3 pins `{name}` as the only parameter grammar, so a conforming shell reads `:caseRef` as literal text. The route stays reachable by handle and only its deep-link address degrades — loudly, which is the point.
repair: A `pattern` on `Route.path` in surface.schema.json admitting only the pinned grammar, plus authoring-tool emission (finding F8, owner: Surface). Making the renderer strict is necessary and not sufficient — the authored bundle is where the two grammars meet.
beforeThisReconciliation: The shell matched BOTH grammars in one pass and reported ROUTE-PARAM-GRAMMAR alongside, so the deep link worked here and 404d in any other conforming renderer.
